note: Seed register. Keys: id, t tier (1 safety, 2 water, 3 asset, 4 cosmetic), c category, i item, s short label, e repeat months (0 once), d first due date, w who, p licensed pro, v vendor, st status, n notes.

tasks.i: Level 2 chimney inspection with camera scan of every flue
tasks.n: Boilers vent through the right-hand chimney as seen from the front door. Liner type unknown. Mortar debris on dampers and flues. Decorative candles only, 1 to 2 days a year; hold off until the scan is done.

tasks.i: Annual sweep and flue check of the active boiler chimney
tasks.n: Set the date and interval after the Level 2 inspection (S01). Confirm whether the flue is lined (stainless or clay).

tasks.i: Combustion and draft test on both boilers, written report
tasks.n: New windows and spray foam make the house tighter. Ask for CO in flue gas, draft and efficiency readings.

tasks.i: Boiler service (burner, nozzle, filters, controls)
tasks.n: Last service date to confirm. Ask them to check the pressure relief valve, expansion tank, low-water cutoff and circulators. Enter the visit date once JJ Donovan books it.

tasks.i: Oil tank inspection and vent alarm check, both basement tanks
tasks.n: Inspected annually, no leaks or rust. Vent alarm status unknown. Record tank age and capacity from the labels.

tasks.i: Confirm clearance and ignition barrier where spray foam meets the chimneys
tasks.n: Foam has a break point around the chimneys. Ask RPD whether an ignition barrier was applied and whether clearances meet code. Get the foam spec and warranty.

tasks.i: Test CO and smoke alarms
tasks.n: Hardwired and interconnected, in every room and hallway. CO detectors installed 2026. Record install dates from the labels and replace per the manufacturer date.

tasks.i: Check fire extinguishers (one per floor)
tasks.n: Check gauge and expiration date.

tasks.i: Dryer vent cleaning
tasks.n: Confirm there is a dryer, and the vent path and length.

tasks.i: Photograph the label on each of the 3 panels and record amperage
tasks.n: Amperage unknown. Breaker panels. No knob-and-tube, cloth-sheathed or aluminum wiring reported.

tasks.i: Get permit numbers for the 2021 and 2026 electrical work
tasks.n: No permits reportedly pulled. Ask the electrician or the town. Matters for insurance and resale.

tasks.i: Test GFCI outlets
tasks.n: GFCIs in place. No flickering, buzzing or warm outlets or switches reported.

tasks.i: Lead inspection or risk assessment by a licensed lead inspector
tasks.n: 1813 house, paint history unknown, toddler in the home. Exterior repainted in 2024 by a painter without RRP certification and no lead test. Ask the pediatrician about blood lead screening. Confirm state lead law requirements with the inspector.

tasks.i: Soil lead test at the foundation drip line and play areas
tasks.n: Sample after thaw. Relates to the 2024 exterior paint work.

tasks.i: Review lead and asbestos reports from the 2026 water-damage work
tasks.n: No lead or asbestos found. Check which materials were sampled. Plaster, boiler and duct insulation, and flooring in unaffected areas may be untested. Test before any future renovation.

tasks.i: Retest radon
tasks.n: Windows and attic insulation changed the envelope in 2025 and 2026. Test during the heating season with the house closed.

tasks.i: Well water test: coliform and nitrate
tasks.n: Last test date unknown. The well feeds the irrigation and the 3 exterior spigots.

tasks.i: Well water broad panel: arsenic, uranium, radon, PFAS, metals
tasks.n: Bedrock wells in New England often show these. Matters if a child drinks from or plays with the hose.

tasks.i: Winterize irrigation: blow out lines, drain, disconnect hoses
tasks.n: Do before the first hard freeze. Well-fed system.

tasks.i: Clean gutters and check downspout extensions
tasks.n: After leaf drop. Some downspouts discharge at the base of the house.

tasks.i: Cap the unused chimney flues
tasks.n: All flues are uncapped. Open flues let in rain and freeze-thaw. The cap on the active boiler flue must not restrict venting; coordinate with S01.

tasks.i: Ground-level roof and flashing check, plus after major storms
tasks.int: Twice a year and after storms
tasks.n: Foam on the roof deck hides leaks from the attic side. Chimney flashing is thin metal. Look for lifted shingle tabs.

tasks.i: Check for ice dams and snow load after heavy snow
tasks.n: The 2026 damage came from ice dams under poor insulation. Insulation is now fixed; watch the first winter. Use Log a check after each heavy snow.

tasks.i: Confirm no cross-connection between well plumbing and municipal supply
tasks.n: Irrigation and exterior spigots are on the well. Plumber to confirm separation and whether any backflow preventer is installed.

tasks.i: Check attic air handlers for hot-water coils, freeze protection and minimum attic temperature
tasks.n: If coils carry boiler water, a power or boiler outage in a deep freeze can burst them. Ask about a glycol loop and low-temperature alarms.

tasks.i: Install water leak sensors: boiler and water heater area, basement low point, well tank, attic AC pans
tasks.n: Choose sensors that alert phones.

tasks.i: Clear attic AC condensate drains and test float switches
tasks.n: Attic units sit above finished space. Check secondary pans too.

tasks.i: Well pump and pressure tank service
tasks.n: Both are in the basement. Service history unknown, so the date is a placeholder until a contractor is booked.

tasks.i: Inspect the indirect water heater (Therma-Flow TFI) and record its age
tasks.n: Stainless indirect tank. Age unknown; read the label. Check the relief valve and connections.

tasks.i: Exercise the main water shutoff
tasks.n: Main shutoff is in the basement, facing the street. Tag it.

tasks.i: Check the fieldstone foundation and the 2001 addition joint after heavy rain
tasks.n: Light moisture in heavy rain is rare. No sump or dehumidifier. Look at the joint where the poured 2001 foundation meets the fieldstone.

tasks.i: Replace filters on all air handlers
tasks.n: 3 Bosch heat pumps (basement) and 2 AC units (attic). Record filter sizes.

tasks.i: Locate roof warranty paperwork (shingle manufacturer and Duval Roofing) and register the shingles
tasks.n: Ask Duval and RPD to confirm the shingle warranty allows an unvented, foamed attic.

tasks.i: File Andersen window warranty and registration (2025)
tasks.n: About 35 windows. No storm windows.

tasks.i: File spray foam spec and warranty
tasks.n: Open and closed cell foam on the roof deck.

tasks.i: Register HVAC equipment: Bosch heat pumps (2024) and Mitsubishi AC (2026)
tasks.n: Record model and serial numbers.

tasks.i: Create a home records folder in Drive: permits, warranties, reports, receipts
tasks.n: Include the 2021 and 2026 electrical work, the 2026 insurance claim file, and the lead and asbestos reports.

tasks.i: Review homeowner's insurance coverage
tasks.n: Confirm it reflects the 2026 roof, spray foam, windows and electrical. Ask about water backup and ordinance or law coverage for an 1813 house.

tasks.i: Annual service of the 3 Bosch heat pumps
tasks.n: Installed 2024. Service vendor to confirm.

tasks.i: Annual service of the Mitsubishi attic AC
tasks.n: Installed 2026.

tasks.i: Plan replacement of the older attic AC (about 2000)
tasks.n: Roughly 26 years old, likely R-22 refrigerant. Get 2 to 3 quotes in the off-season. Make, model and age to confirm.

tasks.i: Certified arborist evaluation of the large maple and trees near the roof or house
tasks.n: Maple has a co-dominant leader and tar spot. No arborist visit to date.

tasks.i: Orkin quarterly pest service
tasks.n: Plan covers wood-destroying insects, per owner. Enter the next visit date from Orkin.

tasks.i: Ask Orkin for a written annual wood-destroying insect report
tasks.n: Old powder post beetle signs, not recent.

tasks.i: Inspect sills, beams and basement framing
tasks.n: Fieldstone foundation. No issues with sills, beams or floors reported.

tasks.i: Evaluate snow guards over entries and the brick walkway
tasks.n: New roof has none. Check where snow and ice would slide.

tasks.i: Look for new plaster cracks, stains or bulges
tasks.n: Downstairs is a mix of plaster and lath and drywall from the 2001 addition and 2026 repairs.

tasks.i: Check fieldstone pointing and chimney brick mortar
tasks.n: No deterioration visible now. Use binoculars for the chimney tops.

tasks.i: Walk the exterior for paint failure, caulk gaps and rot
tasks.n: White painted wood siding, repainted in 2024. No peeling or chalking now. Use lead-safe practices; do not sand or scrape until lead testing (S13) is done.

tasks.i: Irrigation spring startup and head check
tasks.n: Well-fed system.

tasks.i: Check retaining walls and brick walkway for heave after thaw
tasks.n: Stone retaining walls and brick walkway.

tasks.i: Asphalt driveway crack fill and sealcoat
